sections.title: Concerning the pursuit of righteous judgment.

verses.text: የምድር ገዥዎች ሆይ፥ ጽድቅን ውደዷት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ኀይል በበጎ ዕውቀት አስቡት፥ በቅን ልቡናም ፈልጉት።
በማይፈታተኑት ሰዎች ዘንድ እርሱ ይገኛልና። በማይክዱት ሰዎችም ዘንድ ይገለጣልና።
ጠማማ አሳብ ከእግዚአብሔር ያርቃል፤ የተፈተነችም ኀይል አላዋቂዎችን ትዘልፋቸዋለች።
በተተነኰለች ሰውነት ጥበብ አትገባምና፤ ለኀጢአት በተገዛ ሰውነትም አታድርምና።
ተግሣጽን የሚገልጽ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ክፉውን ትምህርት ያርቃልና፥ ከሰነፎችም ልቡና ድል ነሥቶ ይሄዳልና በሚመጣም ጊዜ ክፉውን ይዘልፈዋል።
ጥበብን የሚገልጽ መንፈስ ሰው ወዳጅ ነውና፥ በከንፈሩ የሚሳደበውንም አያነጻውም። እግዚአብሔር በኵላሊቶቹ ምስክር ነውና፥ ነዋሪ ጕበኛም ልቡናውን ይመረምረዋል፤ አንደበቱንም ይሰማዋል።
የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ዓለሙን መልትዋልና። ዓለምንም ሁሉ የያዘው እርሱ ነገራቸውን ፈጽሞ ያውቃልና።
ስለዚህ ከሚነገር ከዐመፃ ነገራቸው ምንም ከእርሱ አይሰወርም። ሥራውን በመግለጥ ፍርዱ አይተላለፈውምና።
ክፉዎችን በልቡናቸው ምክር ይመረምራቸዋልና፥ የነገራቸውም ድምፅ ለበደላቸው ዘለፋ ሊሆንባቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይደርሳልና።
ስለ ቅንአት ሥራውን ሁሉ የሚሰማ አይደለምና፥ የነጐርጓርም ድምፅ ከእርሱ አይሰወርም።

Beware of the deceitful words; do not be enticed by the flatteries of the wicked; for that which is vile shall not come forth in vain, and the mouth that speaks in deceit shall bring destruction upon a man.

sections.title: The Lord did not create death.

verses.text: Do not let error lead to death in your life; and do not bring destruction by your own hands.
For the Lord God did not create death; nor does He take pleasure in the destruction of the living.

For He created the creature to dwell, and the creation of the world is for the sake of abundance; and concerning them, the sting of destruction has not been present; nor has dominion over the grave been established upon the earth.
The righteous shall not die.
But the wicked have called upon Him with their hands and with their words; they have plotted against Him. And in Him, they have perished.
For it is fitting for His kin to be, and they made a covenant with Him.

sections.title: Concerning evil thoughts.

verses.text: They said among themselves, without considering the matter of the day, "Our life is but brief, and it is filled with sorrow. For man has no remedy for death, and there is none known who has returned from the grave."
"We have been created in vain, and henceforth we shall not be created; for our breath is like a puff of smoke. And within our hearts, there is a word of flickering movement."
"After death, our flesh shall become a tomb; and our spirits shall be like smoke that disperses."
"Our name shall fade with time; and there is none who remembers our works. Our life passes like a cloud; it disperses like smoke; and in the heat of the sun, it is like a flower that withers."
"Our life passes like a shadow; therefore, there is no refuge from our death; for none shall return."
"Come, let us do good in that which is pleasant; while we are in our youth, let us do that which brings joy to our bodies."
"Let us drink wine, for its price is high; let us take the sweet fragrance of the flower, for it shall not be lost."
"Let us not be ashamed of our glory; for no one shall be found who does not partake of our pride."
"Among us, let there be none who does not partake of our joy; for he is our fortune, and our inheritance, and in every place, let there be a sign of our joy."
"Let us take the poor man as our own; and let us not forsake our friend; if he is of great age, let us not abandon him who has risen from the dust."
ኀይላችን የጽድቅ ሕግ ይሁነን፤ ደካማ ሕሊና የተናቀ ይባላልና።
ኑ፤ ጻድቁን እንግደለው፤ በእኛ ጭንቅና ጽኑዕ ሆኖብናልና፥ ሥራችንንም ይቃወማልና፤ ሕግ በማጣታችንም ያሽሟጥጠናልና፥ የትምህርታችንንም በደል ይሰብካልና።
“እግዚአብሔርንም ማወቅ በእኔ አለ” ይላል፤ ራሱንም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ያደርጋል።
ሕሊናችንንም የሚዘልፍ ሆኖብናል።
በመልኩም በእኛ ጭንቅ ሆኖብናል፤ አኗኗሩም ከሌላ ጋር አይመሳሰልም፤ መንገዱም ልዩ ነው።
በእርሱ ዘንድም የተናቅን ሆነናል፤ ከርኵሰትም እንደሚርቅ ከመንገዳችን ይርቃል። የጻድቃንን መጨረሻ ያመሰግናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም አባቱ እንደ ሆነ ይመካል።
ነገሩም ቀዋሚ እንደ ሆነ እንይ፥ ከመልኩም የተነሣ የሚሆነውን እንመርምር።
የእግዚአብሔርስ እውነተኛ ልጅ ከሆነ ያድነው፤ ከሚቃወሙትም እጅ ይታደገው።
ቅንነቱንም እናውቅ ዘንድ በስድብና በመከራ እንመርምረው። ትዕግሥቱንም በክፉ እንፈትነው።
እንደ ቃሉ ረዳት ይሆነው እንደ ሆነ የከፋና የተዋረደ ሞትን እንፍረድበት።

sections.title: The heart is as one that is troubled.

verses.text: Consider this matter; for in this, their hearts have been hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
They have not known the mystery of the Lord; neither have they esteemed the worth of the righteous; they have not recognized the great honor of the pure souls who are without blemish.
The Lord has created man without death, and He has created him in His own image.
However, through the cunning of the devil, death entered, and it came into this world.
And they who are of his portion have sought to overcome death.

sections.title: The saints are preserved by the grace of God.

verses.text: የጻድቃን ነፍስ ግን በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ናት፤ መከራም አያገኛቸውም።
በሰነፎች ዓይኖች ግን የሞቱ መሰሉ፤ በሞትም ከዚህ ዓለም መውጣታቸው ክፋት እንዳለባቸው ተቈጠረ።
ሞታቸውም ጥፋት መሰለ፤ እነርሱ ግን በሰላም አሉ።
በሰው ፊትም ቢፈረድባቸው ተስፋቸው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሞት የሌለባት ፍጽምት ሕይወት ናት።
ጥቂት መከራ ተቀብለው ብዙ ክብር ያገኛሉ። እግዚአብሔር ፈትኗቸው ለእርሱ የተገቡ ሆነው አግኝትዋቸዋልና።
ወርቅ በከውር እንዲፈተን ፈተናቸው፤ እንደሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም ተቀበላቸው።
በሚጐበኙበትም ወራት እንደ ፀሐይ ያበራሉ፤ በብርዕ ላይ የወደቀ የእሳት ፍንጣሪ እንዲሰፋ በክብር እየሰፉ ይሄዳሉ።
አሕዛብን ይገዛሉ፤ በሕዝብም ላይ ይሠለጥናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ለዘለዓለም ይነግሥላቸዋል።
በእርሱ የሚያምኑ ሰዎች እውነትን ያውቃሉ፤ ጸጋና ምሕረት ለመረጣቸው ነውና፥ የተገለጠ ጕብኝቱም ለጻድቃኑ ነውና ምእመናን በእርሱ ፍቅር ጸንተው ይኖራሉ።

sections.title: The wicked shall be consumed by their own wickedness.

verses.text: Evil men, however, shall receive evil judgment as they have imagined; and those who have forsaken the truth are far from God.
Those who despise wisdom and instruction are fools; their pride is in vain; their weakness and their suffering are of no benefit; their works are in vain.
Their wives are as widows; their children are as orphans; their lineage is forsaken.

sections.title: Concerning Living in Purity

verses.text: She is a woman who is without sin, a vessel that knows not the source of iniquity; she is free from transgression, and in the time when her soul is visited, she shall find fruit.

She who is chosen shall give the value of her faith; for in the house of the Lord, she shall be granted favor, and she who does not work with her hands shall not be guilty, for she is pure and thinks not evil against the Lord.
The fruit of a righteous man is honor and beauty; for his knowledge shall not be subject to decline.
But the children of the wicked shall be consumed by the sword; and the child born of a lawless bed shall perish.
Though their life may abound upon the earth, it shall not be counted; and their name shall be as a shadow in their end.
Even if they hasten to death, on the day of judgment, hope and rest shall not be theirs.
For the generation of the wicked is evil in its end.
To be without good deeds is a complete work; for it is known before God and before man, and thus it is called the name of life.
Though she is in this world, she is honored; and when she has passed, she shall be loved forever; in this world, she is a crown of glory that does not fade, and she shall dwell in honor.
The children of the wicked shall not be many; nor shall the fruit of the vain be known; nor shall the strong prevail.
For a time, if a branch should bear fruit, the wind shall not shake it; and by its wind, it shall be uprooted.
Its branches shall not wither, and its fruit shall not be fit for food; for the time is not right, nor shall it be suitable for eating.
The children born of the wicked shall be witnesses of their mother's and father's iniquity in the time of reckoning.
But the righteous man, when the time of death comes, shall dwell in rest.
Honor and glory are not measured by age; nor are they counted by the number of years.
The knowledge of man is his strength; and the honor of the righteous is a dwelling without fear.
A man who brings joy to the Lord shall be beloved by Him; and when he dwells among sinners, he shall be distinguished.
And if one does not change his knowledge, this shall not be, for he shall rise and depart, having not cast off his deceitful body.
The integrity of the wicked shall consume good works; and the freedom of the heart shall be changed by the vanity thereof.
Though he may die in a short time, he hath completed many years.
His soul rejoiceth in the Lord; therefore, he is separated from the wicked and hath gone forth in joy.

Yet the distinguished among men do not perceive this, nor have they set their hearts to understand it; for the grace of the Lord is for the righteous, and the mercy of forgiveness is for those who are chosen.

sections.title: The victory of the saints and the judgment of the wicked.

verses.text: The righteous man, after he has died, shall judge the wicked who are alive in life. And the wicked man, swiftly at the time of his death, shall be judged with the multitude of his sins, and his age shall be increased over the wicked.
The wise shall not consider the death of the righteous, for the Lord shall not remember what he has suffered for him, nor shall they reflect on what has befallen him.
They shall not consider him, but in him they shall be troubled; yet the Lord shall be angry with them.

After this, they shall be for the wicked death; for the everlasting dead shall be a snare for those who are ensnared. They shall be cast away, and they shall be scattered; and without a word, they shall fall before them. From their foundation, they shall be uprooted; for they shall be like the earth that has been opened for eternity, and they shall be as those who are destroyed; their remembrance shall perish.
In fear, they shall draw near to perish for their sins; and their sins shall be revealed before them and shall overwhelm them.
ያንጊዜ ጻድቁ፦ መከራ ባጸኑበትና ድካሙን በካዱ፥ ነገሩንም በናቁ ሰዎች ፊት በብዙ መገለጥ ይቆማል።
በግርማና በክፉ ማስፈራራት ሆኖ ባዩት ጊዜ ይታወካሉ፤ ድንቅ ስለሚሆን ደኅንነቱም ይደነቃሉ።
እየተጸጸቱና በተጨነቀ መንፈስ እየጮኹ እርስ በርሳቸው ይናገራሉ፦ እንዲህም ይላሉ፥ “ቀድሞ በኛ በሰነፎች ዘንድ መሣቂያና ማሽሟጠጫ የሆነው፥
ሥራውን ስንፍና፥ ሞቱንም የተናቀ ያደረግንበት ይህ ነውን?
እንዴት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ሆነ? ርስቱስ እንዴት ለቅዱሳን ሆነች?
ስለዚህ ከቀና መንገድ ወጥተን ስተናል፥ የጽድቅ ብርሃንም አልተገለጠልንም፥ ፀሐይም አልወጣልንም።
በደልንና ጥፋትን በመንገዳችን ሞላን፤ በምድረ በዳም ሄድን፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መንገድ አላወቅንም።
“ትዕቢት ምን ጠቀመን? ከትዕቢት ጋር ያለ ባለጠግነትስ ምን አመጣልን?
ይህ ሁሉ እንደ ጥላ ኀላፊ ነው፤ ፈጥኖም እንደሚሄድ ወሬ ነው።
በባሕር ላይ እንደሚሄድ፥ ውኃም በማዕበሉ እንደሚነጥቀው፥ ያለፈበት ፍለጋው እንደማይገኝ፥ በማዕበሉም መካከል አካሉ የሄደበት መንገድ እንደማይታወቅ መርከብ፥
በአየር ላይ የሚበርር ዎፍ የሄደበት ፍለጋው እንደማይገኝ፥ በበረረ ጊዜ ቀላሉን አየር እየከፈለ ፈጥኖ ይሄዳልና፥ ክንፉንም እያርገበገበ፥ ፈጥኖ ይበርራልና ከሄደም በኋላ በነፋሱ ውስጥ ያለፈበት ምልክቱ እንደማይገኝ፥
ይህም ባይሆን የተወረወረ ፍላፃ ሰንጥቆት ያለፈው አየር ተመልሶ እንደሚገጥም፥ በአየር ውስጥ የሄደበትም እንደማይታወቅ፥
እኛም እንዲሁ ነን፤ በተወለድን ጊዜ ጠፋን። በክፋታችን ጠፋን እንጂ በጎ ምልክትን እናሳይ ዘንድ አልተገባንም።”
የክፉዎች ሰዎች ተስፋቸው ነፋስ እንደሚበትነው ትቢያ፥ በነፋስ ቀልጦ እንደሚጠፋ ረቂቅ ውርጭ፥ በነፋስም ተበትኖ እንደሚጠፋ ጢስ፥ አንድ ቀንም አድሮ እንደሚሄድ መጻተኛ ስም አጠራር ነው።

sections.title: The righteous shall be rewarded.

verses.text: The righteous, however, shall dwell forever; their worth is precious in the sight of the Lord; their protection is in the heights.
Therefore, they shall receive the crown of glory and majesty from the hand of the Lord; for He shall adorn them in the day of His favor, and He shall assist them with His mighty arm.
They shall wield the perfect weapon of righteousness; to vanquish their foes, they shall employ the instruments of warfare.
They shall be clothed in the armor of righteousness, and the head of judgment shall not be found wanting among them.
They shall also bear the shield of truth that cannot be shaken.
The sword shall be as sharp as a razor; and the world, being with Him, shall not recognize those who oppose.
Swiftly shall the light of the righteous shine upon the wicked; the flames of judgment shall pursue them directly. As a good tree is uprooted, so shall they be cast out from their places of refuge.
The light of the righteous shall swiftly descend like snow; the waters of the sea shall be poured out upon them; the floods shall overflow, and they shall be swept away.
The mighty wind shall shake them; as the tempest shall terrify them; for sin shall cleanse the earth entirely, and the wicked shall be revealed and cast down.

sections.title: The Responsibility of Rulers

verses.text: O ye princes, hearken; give heed; ye mighty who possess the earth, be ye aware.
Ye who possess much of the earth, and who are numerous in the army, give heed to your name.
For the Lord God hath given you strength; your dominion is from on high; He is the one who provides for your sustenance; He shall guide your counsel.
How is it that ye, being the messengers of the king, do not fear the judgment of the day? How is it that ye do not guard the law? How is it that ye do not walk in the way of the Lord?
Swiftly shall the stone that is cast upon you return upon your heads; a severe judgment shall be upon the mighty.
But for the poor who is fallen, he shall be delivered from the work of righteousness; yet the mighty shall be tried with a strong examination.
For the Lord doth not regard the face of man; He doth not fear the greatness of any; thus, He shall consider both the small and the great, for He created them all; He shall take them unto Himself.
But to the mighty, a strong examination shall come upon them.
O ye wicked and oppressors, this matter is for you, that ye may know wisdom and not be foolish.
Truly, those who keep the commandment shall be honored, and those who have learned shall find mercy.
Therefore, I beseech you, my brethren, to seek mercy and kindness, that you may find them in abundance.

sections.title: The value of wisdom.

verses.text: Wisdom is the crown of her glory; her beauty shall not be diminished; those who love her shall hasten to see her, and those who seek her shall find her.
She shall reach those who love her; she shall reveal herself to them beforehand.
For he who keeps her shall always find her, and he who is diligent in seeking her shall not be weary.
To think of her is the consummation of knowledge; therefore, he who hastens to her shall live without sorrow.
She shall come to those who seek her, and along the way, like a shadow, she shall appear to them; in every thought, she shall meet them.
The beginning of wisdom is to desire instruction; and to desire instruction is to think of her.
To think of her is to guard the law; and to guard the law is to understand life.
And life shall lead a man to God.
To desire wisdom shall lead you to the kingdom.
O rulers of the nations, when you have turned to the throne and the great kingdom, speak of wisdom that it may endure forever.

What is wisdom? How was it in the beginning? I shall declare it unto you; I shall not hide its secret from you. Yet from ancient times, I shall search for its essence; I shall make known its nature to you; and I shall not withhold the truth.
I shall not dwell in the midst of the proud; for such a one shall not be united with wisdom.
The multitude of the wise is the Savior of the world.
A wise king is a protector for his people; heed his words, for they shall be of benefit to you.

sections.title: For every man is a liar.

verses.text: I too am a man like all, for I am the son of the earthly Adam, created beforehand; and in the womb of my mother, I was formed in flesh.
In the time of my coming forth, I was found of the seed of my father and by the will of my mother; I lived ten months, being nourished in blood.
When I was created, I breathed the soul like every man; and in my suffering, I descended to the earth; and at the beginning of the word, I shed my tears like all.
I was wrapped in swaddling clothes, and with care, I was nurtured.
There is no beginning of birth that is unique among the princes.
All have come into this world, and all have the same exit.

sections.title: Solomon's love was for wisdom.

verses.text: ስለዚህ ነገር ጸለይሁ፤ ዕውቀትም ተሰጠኝ፤ ለመንሁ፤ የጥበብም መንፈስ ወደ እኔ መጣ።
ከበትረ መንግሥትና ከዙፋንም ይልቅ አከበርኋት፤ ብዕልንም ከእርስዋ ጋር ሳመዛዝን እንደ ኢምንት አደረግኋት።
ወርቅ ሁሉ በእርሷ ዘንድ እንደ ጥቂት አሸዋ ነውና፤ ብሩም በእርስዋ ዘንድ እንደ ጭቃ ነውና፥ ዋጋ በሌለው ዕንቍ አልመሰልኋትም።
ከሕይወትና ከውበትም ፈጽሜ ወደድኋት፤ ከእርሷ የሚወጣ የብርሃን ነጸብራቅ አይወሰንምና፥ ደግሞም አይጠፋምና ስለ ብርሃን ፋንታ ትሆነኝ ዘንድ መረጥኋት።
ከእርሷ ጋር በአንድነት በጎ ነገር ሁሉ መጣልኝ፤ ቍጥር የሌለው ባለጠግነትም በእጆችዋ አለ።
ጥበብ የእነዚህ ሁሉ አበጋዛቸው ናትና በሁሉ ደስ አለኝ፤ ጥበብ የእነዚህ ሁሉ አስገኛቸው እንደ ሆነች አላወቅሁም ነበር።
ይህን ባወቅሁ ጊዜ ያለ ክፋትና ያለ ቅንአት እርሷን እሰጣለሁ፤ ብልጽግናዋንም አልሰውርም።
ለሰውም የማያልቅ መዝገብ ናት፤ ገንዘብ ያደረጓትም ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ደረሱ፤ ሀብትን የምትገልጽ የምክር ሥራ ስለ ሆነችም ተወዳጇት።
ለእኔም እግዚአብሔር የሚወደደውን ነገር እናገር ዘንድ፥ ለሚሰጠውም ሰው የሚገባውን አስብ ዘንድ ጥበብን ሰጠኝ። ወደ ጥበብ የሚመራ፥ ጠቢባንንም ቅን የሚያደርግ እርሱ ነውና።
እኛ ሁላችን በእጁ ነንና፤ ነገራችንም ሁሉ ሥራችንንም ማወቅና መረዳት በእጁ ነውና።
ያለ ሐሰት ነዋሪ የሚሆን የዕውቀት ነገርን ሰጠኝ፤ ዓለም ጸንቶ የሚኖርበትንም ሥርዐት፥ የፀሐይን፥ የጨረቃንና የከዋክብትንም ሥራ አውቅ ዘንድ፤
የዘመኑን መጀመሪያውንና መጨረሻውን፥ መካከሉንም፥ የቀኑን መመላለስ፥ የጊዜውንም መለዋወጥ፥
የዘመናትን ዑደት፥ የከዋክብትንም አኗኗር፥
የእንስሳንም ጠባይ፥ የአራዊትንም ቍጣ፥ የነፋሳትንም ኀይል፥ የሰውንም አሳብ፥ ዛፎችንም ለይቶ ማወቅ፥ የሥሮችንም ተግባር ኀይል አውቅ ዘንድ ሰጠኝ።
የሥራው ሁሉ አስገኝ እርሱ ጥበብን አስተምሮኛልና የተገለጸውንና የተሰወረውን ሁሉ ዐወቅሁ።

sections.title: The Way of Wisdom

verses.text: For she possesses the spirit of wisdom; He is holy, being the only begotten in birth, and though one, His wealth is abundant. She is swift, her motion is created, her word is admirable, wise, devoid of deceit, without ancientness, a dweller, loving kindness, swift, and there is none who can hinder her from doing good.

A man is a friend, a friend of wisdom, knowledgeable, true, without deceit, steadfast, able to do all things, able to govern all things, pure and wise, and she is one who guides the souls that are swift.
The movement of wisdom is created from all movements. In all things, she shall be vast; concerning her purity, she shall go forth in all directions.
She is the breath of the Almighty God, the known one, glorious and pure, the mighty God, the manifestation of His glory. Therefore, there is no impurity that can approach her.
She is the ancient light, the unquenchable one, and the work of God is her dwelling; she is the abode of His kindness.

Being one, she is able to do all things; she herself, while existing, shall perfect all things, and in every generation, she shall be transferred into the bodies of the righteous; and the friends of God and His prophets shall be made by her.
There is none who is loved by God apart from the one who dwells with wisdom.
She is more admirable than the sun, and surpasses all the order of the stars; when she is weighed against light, she shall be found to be more radiant before it.
The light changes to night, but wisdom shall not be overshadowed by any evil thing.

sections.title: Solomon's love was for wisdom.

verses.text: ጥበብ ከዳርቻ እስከ ዳርቻ ድረስ ደኅና ሆና ትደርሳለች፤ በቸርነትዋም ሁሉን ትሠራለች።
እኔም ከጐልማሳነቴ ጀምሮ ወደድኋት፤ ፈለግኋትም። ለእኔም ሙሽራ አድርጌ እወስዳት ዘንድ ወደድሁ። ደም ግባትዋንም ወደድሁ።
የዝምድናዋም ቸርነት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ያቀርባልና ሁሉን የሚገዛ እርሱ ወደዳት።
የእግዚአብሔርን ምሥጢር ለማወቅ መካር ናትና፥ የሥራውም ወዳጅ ናትና።
እርሷም ባለችበት ዘንድ ብልጽግና አለ፤ በዚህ ዓለም ገንዘብ ላደረጓት ሰዎች ከሁሉ ትመረጣለች፤ ሁሉን የምታደርግ ጥበብን የሚበልጣት ምንድን ነው?
ዕውቀትም ቢደረግ በእርሷ ነው፤ ካሉትም ሁሉ ከእርሷ የሚበልጥ ብልህ ማን ነው?
እውነትን የወደደ ሰውም ቢኖር በእርሷ ነው፤ ድካሟ ያማረ ነውና፥ ንጽሕናንና ጥበብን፥ እውነትንና ብርታትን፥ ትሩፋትንና ደግነትንም ታስተምራለች። በዓለሙ ውስጥም በሰው ሕይወት ከእርሷ የሚሻልና የሚጠቅም ምንም የለም።
ብዙ ዕውቀትንና ደግነትን ያወቀ ሰው ቢኖር በእርሷ ነው፤ የቀደመውንና የሚመጣውንም ሥራ ያወቀ ሰው ቢኖር በእርሷ ነው፤ የነገር መልስንና ፈጥኖ መተርጐምን ቢያውቅም በእርሷ ነው፤ ተአምራትንና ድንቆችን፥ የጊዜያትንና የዓመታትንም መለዋወጥ አስቀድሞ ቢያውቅ በእርስዋ ነው።
እኔም፦ ለበጎ ነገር የምትመክርና የምትገሥጽ ኀዘንንና ትካዝን የምታስተው እንደምትሆን ዐውቄ ከእኔ ጋራ እንድትኖር እይዛት ዘንድ ወደድሁ።
በእርስዋም ምክንያት እኔ ጐልማሳው በብዙዎች ዘንድ ምስጋናን፥ በሽማግሌዎችም ዘንድ ክብርን አገኘሁ።
ለመፍረድ አሳበ ፈጣን ሆንሁ፤ በኀያላኑም ፊት ተደነቅሁ።
ዝም ስልም ታግሠው ይጠብቁኝ ነበር፤ ስናገርም ያዳምጡኝ ነበር፤ መናገርም ባበዛ አፋቸውን በእጃቸው ይይዙ ነበር።
በእርስዋም ምክንያት አለመሞትን አገኘሁ፤ ከእኔም በኋላ ለሚመጡ ሰዎች ለዘለዓለም መታሰቢያን ተውሁ።
ሕዝቡን እሠራራ ነበር፤ አሕዛብም ይገዙልኝ ነበር።
የሚያስደነግጡ የምድር መኳንንትም ሰምተው ይፈሩኝ ነበር፤ በሸንጎ ደግ ሆኜ፥ በጠብም ጊዜ ብርቱ ሆኜ እታይ ነበር።
ከእርሷ ጋር መኖር መራራነት የለበትምና፥ ከደስታና ከሐሤትም በቀር ድካምና ኀዘን አይቀርብምና ወደ ቤቴ በገባሁ ጊዜ በእርሷ ዐርፋለሁ።
ይህንም በራሴ ሳስብ ኖርሁ፤ ከኀጢአትም መንጻት እንደማይቻለኝ ዐውቄ በልቡናዬ በእርስዋ እተጋለሁ፤ የጥበብ ዝምድናዋ ሕያውነት ነውና።
በፍቅሯም መልካም ደስታ አለ፤ በእጅዋ ሥራም የማያልቅ ብልጽግና አለ፤ በነገሯም ውስጥ የዕውቀት ትምህርት አለ፤ ከእርሷም ጋር አንድ በመሆን የሚያስመካ ነገር አለ፤ ለራሴም እወስዳት ዘንድ እየፈለግኋት ሀገሩን ዞርሁ።
እኔ ዐዋቂ ልጅ ነኝ፤ ሰውነቴም በጎ ሆነችልኝ።
ደግ ነኝና ወደ ንጹሕ ሥጋዋ ገባሁ።

If the Lord had not granted me her, I would not have known how to seek Him in my time of need; this counsel is from wisdom. I am aware of whose gift it is, and therefore I have prayed to the Lord for my sustenance.

sections.title: The prayer by which Solomon sought to obtain wisdom.

verses.text: With my whole heart I say, “O God of my fathers, Lord of mercy, by Thy word Thou hast created the whole world;
By Thy wisdom, let man, the creature formed by Thee, be sustained;
And let the world be governed in kindness and righteousness, and let my upright heart be guided by Thy hand;
In Thy sanctuary, grant me wisdom that dwells with Thee, and from Thy lips, let me not be forsaken.
I am Thy servant, and the son of Thy handmaid, a man of diminished strength, and my days are few; I am but a little one to know the law and judgment.
“If there be a perfect man among the sons of men, yet the wisdom that is found in Thee is far greater than he, for he is as nothing before Thee.
Thou hast chosen me as a ruler for Thy people, for the sons of men and for the daughters of men, and hast made me a leader among them.
Upon Thy holy mountain, establish a house of worship; and in Thy refuge, from ancient times, prepare a sanctuary that may serve in Thy holiness.
Thy work, which is known to Thee, was with wisdom; it was from the time of Thy creation of the world; and before Thee, what brings joy to Thee, and what is fitting for Thy command, was known to Thee.
Arise and come to me from the exalted heavens, from Thy glory; and let me dwell with Thee, that I may rejoice in what brings joy to Thee, and let me know what is fitting for Thee.
Thou knowest all the works that I know, and Thou dost make me pure and teach me in all my works; in Thy strength, Thou dost keep me.
Let all my works be beloved; and let me serve Thy kin in truth; for the thrones of the fathers are prepared for me.
"Who is the man that knows the counsel of the Lord? Who is the man that knows what the Lord loves?"
The thoughts of the dead are fearful, and our thoughts are but a whisper.
For the flesh that is consumed shall perish the soul, and it shall be honored; and the earthly dwelling shall hide the heart.
With much toil and labor, when we toil in the earth, we shall find the work that is done; and the work that we do with our hands in weakness, we shall find. But who can comprehend what is in heaven?
Thou hast given me wisdom, and Thy holy spirit, and if there be none to send me to Him from above, who shall know Thy counsel?
Therefore, the paths of those who dwell in this world are easy; and those things that bring joy to thee, men know; and by wisdom, they are judged."

sections.title: Wisdom preserveth a man.

verses.text: This one, who was created before the world, protected the Father of the world; and after He was created, she protected Him as a mother, and she nurtured Him from her own being.
She possessed all things and held power, for she was granted strength.
Even the wicked and the violent man, in his anger, was far from her; and those who sought to destroy her brethren perished in the flood.
The earth, being a witness, did not see her perish; wisdom protected the righteous in their time of destruction, and she provided them with sustenance from the broken tree.
When the nations turned to various wickedness and oppression, she regarded the righteous; for there was no sin and no iniquity before God, and in mercy, she protected her son who was pure.
This one, from among those who perish, distinguished the righteous son; and when fire descended upon the five cities, she protected him in his flight.

To be a witness for their wickedness, even unto this day, the wilderness has remained desolate; her vines, though they may wither in their time, are not entirely lost; the body that has not sinned stands as a reminder, like a stone of salt.

These are those who have been forsaken by wisdom, and through ignorance, they have suffered; knowing their time of destruction, they are not merely like those who have perished. However, the wicked have not been allowed to escape the measure of their iniquity, for their remembrance has been cast away in this world.
Wisdom has delivered those who serve her from distress and suffering.

This one, who fled from the wrath of her brother, led the righteous man on the path to salvation. She revealed the kingdom of God to him; she granted him the knowledge of the holy ones, and from the afflicted, she raised him up, and she multiplied her calling.
And she arose as a guardian from among those who were oppressed and those who were exalted; and she was their helper.

She kept the goods of her enemies as a treasure, and she defended those who were esteemed. For unto the Lord, by her good deeds, she was known to be as one who is steadfast, and in a time of strong trial, she granted them victory.
Wisdom did not separate from the righteous man when he was in distress; however, she descended with him into the pit and preserved him from sin.
Among those who were exalted, she did not depart until the decree of the kingdom was fulfilled; she revealed their falsehoods and their deceit. She bestowed upon them the glory of the world.

sections.title: Wisdom delivered Israel from Egypt, as it were, from bondage.

verses.text: ይህቺም ጥበብ ጻድቅ ሕዝብን፥ ነቀፋ የሌለበት ዘርንም ከሚያስጨንቋቸው አሕዛብ አዳነች።
በእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሰውነትም አደረች፤ በተአምራትና በድንቅ ሥራዎችም የሚያስደነግጡ ነገሥታትን ተቃወመች።
ለቅዱሳንም የድካማቸውን ዋጋ ሰጠቻቸው፥ የተደነቀ መንገድንም መራቻቸው፥ በቀንም ጥላ ሆነቻቸው፥ በሌሊትም ስለ ከዋክብት ብርሃን ፈንታ ብርሃን ሆና አበራችላቸው።
የሚያስፈራ የኤርትራ ባሕርንም አሻገረቻቸው፥ በብዙ ውኃ መካከልም አሳለፈቻቸው።
ጠላቶቻቸውን ግን አሰጠመች፥ እነርሱንም ከጥልቅ ባሕር አወጣቻቸው።
ስለዚህም ነገር ጻድቃን ክፉዎችን ማረኩ። አቤቱ ቅዱስ ስምህንም አመሰገኑ። ተዋጊና አሸናፊ እጅህንም በአንድነት አከበሩ።
ጥበብ የዲዳዎችን አፍ ከፍታለችና፥ የሕፃናትንም አንደበት ቀንቶ የሚናገር አድርጋለችና።

sections.title: Wisdom shall guide the people of Israel as the light doth lead them.

verses.text: She laid her works in the hands of the holy prophet;
Whosoever dwelt in the wilderness, they went and remained there. They were not forsaken, and their dwellings were not abandoned.
They also gathered the fighters; and they were delivered from their enemies.
In the time of their distress, they cried unto Thee, and Thou didst give them water from the rock; and from the strong stone, Thou didst provide for their thirst.
Their enemies were also consumed in this work, and they perished.
And thus, they were troubled, yet in their distress, Thou didst do good unto them.
In the blood of those who were slain, as they were cast into the river that could not be crossed, the fountain of the source flowed forth.
Infants were slain, and to escape their slaughter, Thou didst hasten to give them much water, without hope of preservation.
Likewise, in the time of their distress, Thou didst lead forth their adversaries.
Yet they were humbled by Thy mercy, and the wicked, in the time of their destruction, knew how they were ensnared.
And these, as a father would chastise, You have corrected them. But those, like a king who has no mercy, You have pursued them in wrath.
In this, I have made them a parable. Though they are silent, though they do not dwell, I have grieved for them.
For they have found great sorrow, and the cry of remembering the evil of the past has come upon them.
In their affliction, as You have done good to them, in the time they heard, they rejoiced in the joy that came from the Lord.

sections.title: The punishment that comes upon the wicked.

verses.text: And the wicked, in their transgression, have been cast down; thereafter, in their plotting, they have turned away from Him; and they have been seized by the consequences of their rebellion, and the righteous, though they have been tempted, they have not been led astray.
The mind, in the hearts of others, is filled with wickedness at the time of temptation, for they do not speak, and they have gathered vain riches like beasts.
A man, in his wicked deeds, knows that many creatures are sent to him, so that they may perish.
The world, having no existence, is for the Creator who is able to do all things; with Your right hand, You have created many sheep and great eagles, yet they do not perish.

If it were not so, the stones that were created would not be known, nor would the fire that consumes and devours; if it were not so, the burning coals that are ignited would not be known, nor would the wrath that is filled with the evil eye produce the burning flames.
Their wickedness that can destroy them, or their judgment, is not the only thing; however, their goodness was in their fear and in their destruction.

sections.title: The Lord is mighty in His strength, for He is powerful.

verses.text: ከዚህም በቀር፦ ስታባርራቸው፥ በኀይልህ መንፈስም ስታጠፋቸው፥ በአንዲት ምልክት ይጠፉ ዘንድ በተገባቸው ነበር። ነገር ግን ሁሉን በመጠን፥ በቍጥርና በሚዛን ሠራህ።
የከሃሊነትህ ገናናነት በአንተ ዘንድ ሁልጊዜ ይኖራልና፥ የክንድህ ጽንዐት ኀይልንም ማን ይቃወማታል?
ዓለሙ ሁሉ በፊትህ እንደ ሚዛን ውልብልቢት ነውና፥ በማለዳም በምድር ላይ እንደ ወረደች እንደ ጠል ጠብታ ነውና።
አንተ ሁሉን የምትችል ነህና ሁሉን ይቅር ትላለህ፥ ለንስሓም እየጠበቅኸው የሰውን ኀጢአት ቸል ትላለህ።
ያሉትን ሁሉ ትወዳለህ፥ ከፈጠርኸው ፍጥረትም ምንም የምትንቀው የለም፥ ብትጠላውስ ኖሮ አትፈጥረውም ነበርና።
አንተ ካልወደድኸው በፊትህ እንደምን በጸና ነበር! አንተስ ካልጠራኸው እንደምን በተጠበቀ ነበር!
ለፍጥረቱም ሁሉ ትራራለህ፥ ይቅርም ትላለህ። ሰውን የምትወድድ አቤቱ፥ ሁሉ ያንተ ነውና፥
Your spirit, which is without blemish, is present in all things.

Therefore, you shall cause those who have been wronged to come forth for judgment, and you shall gently lead them, little by little; you shall remind the wicked of their wickedness; and when they are far from their iniquities, in the time of their repentance, O Lord, you shall show mercy upon them, that they may believe in you.

sections.title: Concerning the sin of the Canaanites.

verses.text: በቅድስት ሀገርህ የሚኖሩትን የቀደሙትን ሰዎች፥
ስለ ተጠላ የሟርት ሥራቸውና ከጽድቅ ስለራቀ በዓላቸው፥
ያለርኅራኄም ልጆቻቸውን ስለመግደላቸው፥ የሰዎችን ሆድ ዕቃና ሥጋቸውን ለመብላት፥ ደማቸውንም ለመጠጣት ስለ መፍቀዳቸው ጠልተኻቸዋል። የጌትነትህን ምሥጢራት ማወቅ ከመካከላቸው ርቋልና።
ከማንም ዘንድ ረዳት የሌላቸው ሰዎችንም ይገድላሉ፥ በአባቶቻችንም እጅ ታጠፋቸው ዘንድ ወደድህ።
ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ከሀገሩ ሁሉ በአንተ ዘንድ የከበረች ለእነርሱ የምትገባ ሀገርን ይይዙ ዘንድ ነው።
ነገር ግን ሰውን ይቅር እንደምትል እነርሱንም ይቅር አልኻቸው፤ እነርሱንም ጥቂት በጥቂት እንዲያጠፉ ከሠራዊትህ አስቀድሞ የትንኝ ወራሪን ላክህባቸው።
ያም ባይሆን በየወገኖቻቸው እንዲማርኳቸው ክፉዎችን በጻድቃን እጅ ትጥላቸው ዘንድ አይሳንህም ነበር፥ ያም ባይሆን ለክፉዎች አውሬዎች ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ፥ ያም ባይሆን በአንድ ቃል አዝዘህ ታጠፋቸው ዘንድ አይሳንህም ነበር።
ለእነዚህ የንስሓ ቦታ ሰጥተህ ይህ ጥቂት በጥቂት ይሆን ዘንድ ፈረድህ፤ ይህንም ማድረግህ አኗኗራቸው ክፉ እንደ ሆነ፥ ክፋታቸውም እጅግ እንደ በዛ፥ ዐሳባቸውም ለዘለዓለም እንደማይመለስ ሳታውቅ አይደለም።
ከጥንት ጀምሮ የተረገሙ ዘሮች ናቸውና፥ በበደሉበት በደል ዕድሜን የምትሰጣቸው ማንንም አፍረህ አይደለም።

sections.title: The Lord is the Sovereign of all, for He is.

verses.text: "What have you done?" Who is it that asks you? Who is it that brings forth your judgment? Or who is it that accuses you? Who is it that leads you astray concerning the nations you have created? Who is it that comes to you as a judge to contend with you over the wickedness of men?
That your judgment may not be in violence, there is no other god besides you who thinks of all men.
Whether a king or a ruler, concerning your judgment, they cannot contend with you, for they are but men.
You are the true one who prepares all things in truth, and it is a special work that arises from your power to judge that which is not fitting for judgment.
For from your righteousness springs forth the beginning of truth, and in creating and purchasing all things, you grant forgiveness to all.
The completion of your righteousness reveals your power to those who do not believe, and you will scatter those who do not believe in their destruction.
When you are a mighty protector, you will judge in righteousness. Whenever it may be, you are with those whom you love, and in great kindness, you will dwell among them.
Thus, in such a work, a righteous man ought to be gentle and a friend, teaching your kin; and for your children, you have made a good hope, for you will give to the oppressed a refuge.
For those who are destined for death, these are your children, and in the face of such steadfastness, your judgment will deliver them from evil, for you have shown them the times and the way.
For the good hope and the covenant you have given to your children, how much will you be concerned to judge them?

Therefore, in the time of Thy judgment, we remember Thy mercy; even as Thou dost often chastise our adversaries with many judgments, we place our hope in Thy forgiveness during the time of Thy judgment upon us.

sections.title: Concerning the judgment upon the Egyptians.

verses.text: Yet in this, thou hast pursued the wicked, who dwell in sin and transgression, and hast brought upon them the judgment of their own iniquities.

Concerning their adversaries, they who were oppressed, they have called upon the gods, and for a long time have been led astray in error; even as children without knowledge, they have spoken falsehood.
Therefore, for this reason, as they are like children, thou hast brought judgment upon them according to their measure, as it is fitting for them.
If they do not return from their wickedness, the righteous Lord shall withhold the bread of judgment from them; for they have been troubled in their affliction, and they have cried out in distress.

As they have become like gods, in their worship of these idols, in the time of their judgment, they have known the former things; they have known that the Lord is righteous; therefore, a complete punishment of judgment has come upon them.

sections.title: The vanity of idol worship.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን የማወቅ ጕድለት በልቡናቸው ያለባቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ በእውነት ከንቱ ናቸውና፥ በሚታዩ መልካም ነገሮች ያለውን ያውቁ ዘንድ ተሳናቸው፥ ሥራውንም እያዩ ሠሪውን አላወቁትም።
ነገር ግን እሳትንና ፈጥኖ የሚነፍሰውን ነፋስ፥ ወይም የከዋክብትን ዙረት፥ ወይም የውኃውን ሞገድ፥ ወይም የሰማይ ብርሃናትን ዓለሙን የሚያስተዳድሩ አማልክት አስመሰሏቸው።
በመልካቸው ውበት ደስ ባላቸው ጊዜ እነዚህን ፍጥረታት አማልክት ካደረጓቸው፥ ውበትን የፈጠረ እርሱ ይህን ፍጥረት ፈጥሯልና የእነዚህ ጌታ ፈጽሞ እንደሚበልጥ ይወቁ።
ከኀይላቸውና ከሥራቸው የተነሣ ከተደነቁስ የፈጠራቸው እርሱ ፈጽሞ ኀያል እንደ ሆነ ያስተውሉ።
ፍጡራን የፍጥረታትን ውበት ታላቅነት አይተው የፍጥረታትን ፈጣሪ በእርሱ መስለውታል።
ነገር ግን ከዚህ ጋራ ዳግመኛ አምላክን እየፈለጉት፥ ያገኙትም ዘንድ እየወደዱ ቢሳሳቱ፥ በእነርሱ ላይ የሚኖረው ነቀፋ ጥቂት አይደለም።
ወደ ሥራው ተመልሰው በፈለጉት ነበርና፥ እነርሱ ግን በማየት አበቁ፥ የሚታዩት መልካሞች ናቸውና።
ዳግመኛም ምክንያታቸው ብዙ ነው።
ዓለምን መረዳት እስኪገባቸው ድረስ ይመለከቱ ዘንድ ይህን ያህል ከተቻላቸው የእነዚህን ጌታ ፈጥነው ያገኙት ዘንድ እንዴት አልቻሉም?
ከወርቅና ከብር በጥበብ የተሠሩ የሰው እጅ ሥራዎችን፥ የእንስሳ ምሳሌን፥ ወይም የማይጠቅም የጥንት የእጅ ሥራ ድንጋይን አማልክት ብለው የሚጠሩ እነዚህ ጐስቋሎች ናቸው፥ ተስፋቸውም በሞቱ ነገሮች ላይ ነው።

If there be a carpenter who can shape the wood that is seen and that is twisted, he shall skillfully carve the wood that is good, and he shall craft all its parts with wisdom; he shall make it well and shall prepare it as a useful item for service unto life.
After he has completed his work, he shall be called upon to prepare the food.

The carpenter shall take the wood that is useless, the remnants of the tree, and all that is warped, and he shall engage in his work by shaping it; thereafter, on the day of its completion, it shall appear in the form of a man.
Or he shall work in vain, creating an image of a beast, and it shall be accepted with a red hue; he shall also take the color of its feet and make it red. It shall fill the void in which it stands.
For him, a fitting house shall be constructed; in the place where he works, he shall dwell, and he shall be adorned with iron from the walls.
It is an image, and it seeks assistance; for it cannot help itself, it is cautious lest it fall.
Thereafter, concerning his wealth and his wife, and concerning his children, he shall be called upon; for the soul that is absent shall not be forsaken when it speaks with the idols.
Concerning the sick, he shall be called upon; concerning life, he shall be called upon for sustenance; and concerning help, he shall be called upon for the weak who cannot assist.

Concerning the way, he shall be called upon to move, for he cannot go to where he ought; and he shall be called upon for a single step to where he cannot tread. Concerning brightness and concerning work, concerning attainment, and concerning the work of his hands, he shall be called upon for that which cannot be done; he shall seek strength and the ability to create, for he desires that which has no strength from him.

sections.title: The vanity of idols.

verses.text: The wise man, amidst the tumult of the wicked sea, shall venture forth, and when he departs upon the ship, he shall be delivered from the burden of the vessel, from the wood that may sink and from that which may be broken.
That idol has gained profit through destruction, and the cunning has also gained profit through his cunning.
O Father, Thou who dost guide, indeed Thou dost direct all; Thou hast granted a path in the sea, and amidst the waves, a strong passage.
As one embarks upon the ship, the wise man, lacking understanding, shall be shown how, in truth, all can be saved upon the waters.
Thy work of wisdom is not to be in vain; therefore, men, having been cast down and fallen like wood, shall be lifted up amidst the great and the small ships in the waves.
In times past, the proud have been cast down; the hope of the world has been drowned in the ship, and in Thy hand, it has been turned, and the seed of man has been scattered upon the earth.
This ship shall be established in righteousness, for it is blessed.
That which is made by hand shall perish, for it is said of God that it is a thing of vanity; and he who made it, in his doing, is indeed foolish.
Before God, evil and wickedness have been rightly judged.
The work that is done shall be judged with the one who did it.

Therefore, a trial shall be made against the idols of the nations. To destroy the creation and to ensnare the souls of men, for the ignorant, their feet have become a snare and they have been ensnared.

sections.title: The beginning of the end is to serve idols, for it is thus that it shall come to pass.

verses.text: የዝሙት መጀመሪያዋ ጣዖትን የመሥራት ዐሳብ ነውና፥ እርሱንም ማግኘት የሕይወት ጥፋት ነው።
ከጥንት ጀምሮ አልነበረምና ለዘለዓለሙም አይኖርምና።
ተነጥቀው የመሄዳቸውን ፍጻሜ የሚያፋጥን ስለሆነ በከንቱ ሰው ምክንያት ጣዖት ወደዚህ ዓለም ገባ። ከዚህም በኋላ ጣዖት መሥራትን ዐሰቡ።
ልጁ ሕፃን ሳለ ፈጥኖ በሞት ስለ ተነጠቀ አባቱ ላንድ ልጁ ይጨነቅና ያለቅስ ነበርና፥ ቀድሞ ለሞተው ልጁ ምስል ሠራለት፥ ዛሬ ግን እንደ አምላክ አድርገው አከበሩት። ለኀጢአት የተገዙ ሰዎችም በስውር በዓል አደረጉለት፥ የምሥጢር መሥዋዕትንም ሠዉለት።
ከዚህ በኋላ በዘመን መራቅ የበደልና የዝንጋዔ ልማድ ሥርዐት ሆኖ ተያዘ፥ እንደ ሕግም አድርገው ጠበቁት፥ በክፉዎች መኳንንት ትእዛዝም ጣዖታትን አመለኳቸው።
በሩቅ ስለሚኖሩ ፊት ለፊት ሊያከብሯቸው የማይቻላቸውን ሰዎች ቅርፁ በሩቅ ያለ መልካቸውን ቀረፁ፥ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ክቡር ለሚሆን ለንጉሡም ግልጥ የሆነ ምስል ሠሩለት። የሌለውንም እንዳለ አድርገው በትጋት ይለምናሉ።
ስሕተታቸውንም ያላወቁ ሰዎች በአምልኮታቸው ጸኑ። የጥበበኛውንም ክብር ወደ ጣዖት አምልኮ መለሱ።
ዳግመኛ ገዥውን ንጉሥ አድልቶ ደስ ያሰኘው ዘንድ የሚወድ አለ። ባማረና በተሻለ ሁኔታ ምስሉን ለመሥራት ተራቅቆአልና።
በሥራውም መልክ ማማር ደስ ስላላቸው ብዙ ሰዎች በዚህ ተሳቡ፥ ከጥቂት ቀን አስቀድሞ በትንሽ ክብር የነበረ ሰውንም ዛሬ እንደ አምላክ አደረጉት።
በችግር ወይም በግድ ሰው ሁሉ ተገዝትዋልና ይህ ለሰው መሰናክልን ሆነ፤ ከእነርሱ ጋር አንድነት የሌለውን የፈጣሪን ስም ለሚጠቀሙባቸው ለድንጋይና እንጨት አድርገውታልና።

sections.title: The result of the idol of worship.

verses.text: ዳግመኛም እግዚአብሔርን ካለማወቃቸው የተነሣ ስሕተታቸው አልበቃቸውም፥ ነገር ግን በታላቅ ሰልፍ ሳሉ በስንፍናቸው ይኖራሉ። ይህን ያህል ክፉ የሆነውንም ታላቅ አደረጉ፥ ሰላም ብለውም ጠሩት።
ልጆቻቸውን የሚሠዉ አሉና፤ የተሰወረ ምሥጢርንም ያደርጋሉ፥ በልዩ ሥርዐትም እየተቅበዘበዙ ያስባሉ።
ሕጋቸውንና ጋብቻቸውን አልጠበቁም፤ ነገር ግን ባልንጀራ ባልንጀራውን ይገድለዋል፤ ያም ባይሆን ያባብለዋል፥ በሽተኛም ያደርገው ዘንድ ተስፋ ይሰጠዋል።
ሥራዎቻቸው ሁሉ ደም ከማፍሰስና ነፍስ ከመግደል ጋር፥ ከመስረቅም ጋር፥ ከሐሰትና ከጥፋት፥ ምስጋናንም ከማጕደል ጋር፥ ካለማመንም ጋር፥ ከመሐላና በጎውን ሰው ከማወክ ጋር፥
ዋጋን ካለማሰብ ጋር፥ ሰውነትን ከማስተዳደፍ ጋር፥ ፍጥረትንም ከመለወጥ ጋር፥ የጋብቻን ሥርዐት ከማፍረስ ጋር፥ ከምንዝርና ከርኵሰት ጋር፥ የተቀላቀለ ነው።
ስም የሌላቸው ጣዖቶችን ማምለክ የክፋት ሁሉ መጀመሪያ ነውና፥ የፍጻሜውም ምክንያት ነውና።
የሚያመልኳቸው ሰዎች እንደ እነዚህ ደስ ቢላቸው አእምሮአቸውን ያጣሉና። ያም ባይሆን በሐሰት ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ያም ባይሆን ይሙት በቃውን ያድናሉ፥ ያም ባይሆን ፈጥነው ይምላሉ።
ቃልና ዕውቀት ያላቸው እነዚህ ሁሉን እንደሚያውቅ እንደ ፈጣሪ አድርገው ነፍስ የሌለው ሐሰተኛና ድዳ ጣዖትን ይታመናሉ፥ ቢምሉም እንደሚፈረድባቸው አያስቡም።
እውነተኛ ፍርድ በአንድነት ያገኛቸዋል፥ ጣዖቱን በተመለከቱ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ክፉ ነገርን ዐስበዋልና፥ የፈጣሪን እውነት አቃልለው በግፍና በሐሰት ምለውበታልና።
በኀጢአታቸው የተፈረደባቸውን ፍርድ ለማስተላለፍ ነው እንጂ ኀይሉን ይገልጥብናል ሲሉ የማሉ አይደለምና፤ እንግዲህ ሁልጊዜ ሰውን በሚበድሉ ሰዎች ወንጀል ላይ ፍርድ ትምጣባቸው።

sections.title: The true God is worthy of worship.

verses.text: Thou art our Creator, O Lord, gracious, true, and mighty; by Thy mercy, all things are made.
Knowing Thy power, we are humbled; recognizing our being, we are but Thine.
To know Thee is indeed righteousness, and to know Thy power is the essence of life.
Evil thoughts, the wisdom of man, bear no fruit; they are but the weary toil of vanity, and their works, though adorned, shall not endure.
The goodness of these shall lead them to desire, yet the unwise shall be ensnared; their souls, devoid of movement, shall be drawn to the death of idols.
They who are loved and cherished are those who despise wickedness. Thus shall those who act in such a manner place their hope upon them.

sections.title: The folly of those who worship the idol of the serpent.

verses.text: The worker of the earth shall labor for each one of us in due time, performing the various tasks that are fitting for each. However, thereafter, he shall prepare the instruments for the clean service, and likewise for other works he shall perform in these manners; all of these actions are for a distinct purpose. Yet, this or that is for what benefit, as the judge of the earth, the worker of the earth, is concerned.

The man who is afflicted with sin shall, therefore, work in vain for the dust; this was created from the earth a few days prior. After a few days, he shall return from it to the land of the dead, and concerning his soul, judgment shall be rendered.

In him, the burden shall be borne, and he shall be afflicted because of it, for his life is but brief. It is for this reason that those who work with gold and silver shall be troubled, but it is not for the artisans of brass that it is so; rather, it is for the fallen that honor shall be given.
His heart is steadfast, and his hope shall rise from the dust; his life is exceedingly marred by the earth.
I do not know the one who created and has troubled the soul of the living, nor do I know the spirit of life that is in him.

However, these have made our lives a game and a mockery, and they have made our lives a sign of profit; for I have been troubled by my loss, they say, and after this, it shall be restored, and the sin shall bring forth wealth.
This is known to be utterly burdensome, as it is seen upon the earth and swiftly perishes, like a tree that has been cut down.
All are unknowing and foolish; all who have been taught are separated and are dead. In him, those who are bound are more numerous than the bodies of children.

They are unable to work, to see with their eyes, to breathe with their nostrils, to hear with their ears, to grasp with their hands; their feet are unable to walk, and they have made the idols of the nations their thoughts.
Man has been created, and the spirit that has been given is departed; he has made himself like God, yet for man, it is not possible.
He is the one who is the foundation; in the hand of sin, he shall work the foundation. Since he is alive, these shall not at all be like the living, for he is better than the idols.
The creatures that have been made by the angels, these shall be adorned with beauty; but if these are contemplated with the mind, they shall be distinguished from other angels.
Those creatures that are desired, upon seeing them, one has fulfilled one desire; in one, there is delight; the praise and glory of God is in this abundance.

sections.title: Concerning the affliction of Israel and the destruction of the Egyptians.

verses.text: Therefore, let them be steadfast in their prayers, as is fitting, and let many humble ones be afflicted.

For Your people, You have done good before their enemies, and You have given them satisfaction according to their desires. They shall eat of the food that is special, which You have provided for them.

Yet, when they desired food, they turned back to their own desires, for they were sent forth by their cravings; they were deprived of the bounty of the season. But these, after suffering from the lack of food for a few months, prepared a meal that was special.
Upon these, judgment shall come, for it is a necessity. They are wicked and are sold by force. However, for these, it is only fitting that their enemies see how they are afflicted.

When the wrath of the wicked comes upon them, even if they are surrounded by the serpents of the wicked, they shall be afflicted for a few months, for Your wrath does not endure upon them for a long time.
This shall be a sign to remind them of Your command, that they may be warned against poverty.
O You who deliver all, what has returned from them is in You alone, for it is not merely in seeing that deliverance is found.
In this, test them; as You are the One who delivers from all evil, let our enemies be confounded.
The sting of the scorpion and the bite of the serpent have afflicted them; they have not found relief for their souls; it is fitting that they be judged in such a manner.
But concerning Your children, the teeth of the serpents shall not harm them when they are commanded, for Your goodness has come upon them.

For this reason, let thy law be in remembrance, that ye may not be overwhelmed by the strong tempest; and let not thy works be forgotten, but hasten to call upon Him, that ye may not be overcome by other labors and tribulations.
O Lord, Thy word is the one that delivers all, but the wood that is sought for is not the one that brings salvation, nor is the healer that is sought the one who saves them.
For Thou hast power over life and death, and Thou shalt descend to the gates of Sheol; and from Sheol, Thou shalt bring forth.
Yet man shall perish by evil; the soul, when it is separated from the flesh, shall not return; and the separated soul shall not return.
Yet from Thy hand, there is no escape.

sections.title: And the plague smote the Egyptians as it was commanded.

verses.text: When the wicked rise against thee, in the time of thy knowledge, they are consumed by thy strength; with a special sound and a roar, devoid of mercy and without refuge, they perish in the heavens above, and are consumed by fire.
The wondrous works shall be all consumed in the water, for it is the fire that is mighty and shall prevail. The world is a refuge for the righteous.
The fire shall not harm the beasts sent upon the wicked, that they may not be consumed; yet, when they behold this, they shall know that they are perishing under the judgment of the Lord.
The time shall come when the fire shall consume the earth of the transgressor, as the power of the fire shall be in the midst of the waters.

sections.title: Concerning the fall of Israel.

verses.text: Concerning the fruit, You prepared the food of the angels for Your people, ready without lack, whose flavor surpasses all that is delectable, and You sent them heavenly delicacies that delight the soul.

The heavenly messenger revealed the taste of Your love to Your children, and the flavor that was to be consumed was delightful, serving to fulfill their desires and to satisfy their cravings beyond all other foods.

They stood firm, having taken refuge in the cold against the fire; the flame was raging amidst the cold, and in the midst of the storms, it was roaring, knowing that it would not be extinguished lest it consume the fruits of their enemies.
The righteous, in their steadfastness, shall forsake their own sustenance at the appointed time.
Creator, behold, all creation serves You; You shall bring forth judgment upon the transgressors, and to those who trust in You, You shall grant joy.
Therefore, at that time, Your gift was present, and all Your works were in constant motion; in all the food that was desired and cherished, You provided sustenance.
O Lord, Your word shall keep those who trust in You, for man is not to be compared to the fruit of a different seed; it is known that Your beloved children are aware of this.
The flame that does not extinguish is kindled by a little warmth of the sun, and it has been made bright.
At the rising of the sun, we give thanks to You, and we call upon You, that the sun may come forth to us; let this be known.
For the ungrateful, their condition is as the winter frost that withers, and as the stagnant water that becomes foul.

sections.title: And fear fell upon the Egyptians by night as it had come upon them.

verses.text: Thy judgment is great, and to speak of it is wondrous. Therefore, it is not for the bodies of those who have no teaching from the Creator.

When the Holy One took hold of the people, in the time of their being fortified, even the mighty were seized in the long night of darkness; at that time, they hid beneath the roof of their houses. They fled from the eternal service and were found.

Those who have committed evil, reflecting within themselves, were cast into a house where there was no light; they were imprisoned beneath the ground, greatly trembling, and they were struck against the stone.
Their lamentation could not be kept from the stone, for they began to utter a great voice of lamentation. The evil of their deeds consumed all that was before them.
The light of their fire could not shine even for a single hour, nor could the brightness of the stars illuminate that night of darkness that terrified them.
Yet, rather than this visible form, the great and perfect one was seen, and instead of those which cannot be seen, a single flame of fire was revealed to them.
Upon those who are afflicted, there shall be a garment of pride, a burden of sorrow, the work of death shall be made of gold and silver.
Those who have given hope to cast away the blows and stones from the afflicted body, these fears they have gathered, and they became a refuge for the oppressed.
What they feared not, a great tumult and the cry of serpents surrounded them. They were terrified and fled. They could not see the wind that swept from every direction.
The work of the wicked is an abomination and a cause for judgment; always known and in the mind of the wise, it is regarded as evil and deceitful, and it shall be accepted and performed.
Fear is nothing, but it shall bring forth the judgment of the heart.
Even if there be but a little or a faint trembling of the heart, it is unknown; it is in the midst of the shadows; it is said to be the way that leads to judgment.
Truly, when it cannot be delivered from the pit of Sheol, it is a night that cannot be escaped; they were asleep in their time of distress.

Those who cause distress have greatly troubled them; they are those who bring forth fear by showing their shame, and there is one who brings forth hope for the body; the fear that is unguarded and unheeded has reached them, and the stone of distress has come upon them.
And all that is there is thus; if it be fallen, whether by iron or without iron, it shall be bound in the house of bondage.
Whether it be a servant or a master, if it be cast down in the wilderness, and the earth is made to tremble, whatever it may be: that which it has found has brought upon it a grievous affliction.

Their community is bound by a single dark iron, and that which they have found is thus; it is a trembling that causes them to tremble, or if there be a cry from the trees that have been uprooted, the sound of their branches is sweet, or their song is sweet, the sound of the birds.

Or it is the sound of the rushing waters that go forth with power, or the sound of the beasts that are frightened, or the sound of the animals that run and are not seen, or the cry of the wild beasts that call out in fear, or the sound that rises from the wilderness and the creatures, that calls out to one another in their distress. The affliction that troubles them is thus.
The whole world was to shine with a light that illuminates, for there was no separation and no hindrance; its work was to be fulfilled.
Yet these alone shall take them, for the darkness that is a weight of the night has overshadowed them; they themselves are in darkness, and they are as those who are in the night.

sections.title: For Israel, a light as it has come forth.

verses.text: በጻድቃንህ ዘንድ ግን ታላቅ ብርሃን ነበር፥ እነዚያ ቃላቸውን ይሰሙ ነበርና፥ መልካቸውን ግን አያዩም ነበርና።
እነዚያ የሚወዷቸውን ይደበድቧቸው ነበርና፤ የተበደሉትንም መከራ ስለ አጸኑባቸው እርስ በርሳቸው ይመሰጋገኑ ነበር።
እነዚህ ግን በተላከላቸው የማዳን ስጦታ ደስ አላቸው፥ የማይታወቅ ጎዳናንም ይመራቸው ዘንድ የእሳት ዐምድን ሰጣቸው፥ በሚወደደውም መንገድ የማያቃጥል ፀሐይን ሰጣቸው።
ብርሃንን ያጡ ዘንድ፥ በጨለማም ይታሰሩ ዘንድ ለእነዚያ ይገባቸዋል፤ ለዓለም ይሰጥ ዘንድ ያለው፥ የማያልፍ የሕግህ ብርሃን ያላቸው ልጆችህን አስረው አግዘዋቸዋልና።

sections.title: The death of the firstborn of the Egyptians.

verses.text: የጻድቃን ልጆችን ይገድሉ ዘንድ ባሰቡና በመከሩ ጊዜ፥ ለዘለፋ ሊሆንባቸው አንዱ ሕፃን ተጥሎ ዳነ። በእርሱም ብዙዎች ልጆቻቸውንና ማኅበራቸውን ሁሉ ያለ ርኅራኄ በብዙ ውኃ አጠፋህ።
የተማማሉባትን መሐላ ባወቁ ጊዜ፥ በፍቅር ያስቧት ዘንድ አባቶቻችን ያቺን ሌሊት ዐወቋት።
ለጻድቃን ሕዝብህ ደኅንነትን፥ ለተቃዋሚዎች ጠላቶችም ጥፋትን ሰጠህ።
የሚቃረኑትን እንዳጠፋሃቸው፥ እንዲሁ የጠራኸንን እኛን አክብረኸናልና።
አገልጋዮችህ ጻድቃን ያማረ መሥዋዕትን ይሠዉ ነበረና፥ በመስማማትም የጌትነትህን ሕግ በልቡናቸው አሳድረዋልና በዚህ አምሳል ቅዱሳን መልካሙን ነገር ተቀበሉ፥ መከራውም ለሚገባቸው ነው። አባቶቻችን ግን የምስጋናውን መዝሙር በደስታ ይዘምሩ ነበር።
ነገራቸው ሳይተባበር ከጠላቶች ልቅሶ ጩኸት ጋር ቃላቸው ይገናኝ ነበር። እናቶችም ስለ ልጆቻቸው የልቅሶውን ድምፅ ያደምጡ ነበር።
የባሪያውም ቅጣት ከጌታው ጋር በመቅሠፍት ተካከለ። ጭፍራውንና ንጉሡንም ይህች መከራ እኩል አገኘቻቸው።
ሁሉም በአንድነት በአንድ አምሳል ሞቱ፤ ቍጥር የሌላቸው የሞቱ ሰዎች በድኖችም ነበሩ። በአንዲት ሰዓት የከበረች ፍጥረታቸው ፈጽማ ስለ ጠፋች ሕያዋን የሞቱትን ሰዎች ይቀብሯቸው ዘንድ አልቻሉምና።
ስለ ሟርታቸውም የመጣባቸውን መቅሠፍት ሁሉ አላወቁምና በበኸር ልጃቸው መጥፋት ሕዝቡ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች እንደ ሆኑ ዐወቁ።
ፍጹም ጸጥታ ፍጥረትን ሁሉ በሸፈነ ጊዜ፥ ሌሊቷም በፍጥነቷ መካከል ሳለች፥
Thy word, which is able to do all things, descended as a conqueror and warrior from the heavens, from Thy throne, into the midst of the earth unto destruction.
Thou didst not spare them; Thy command was like a sharp sword, and in the midst of them, their regions were filled with death; the heavens were shaken, and upon the earth they remained.
At that time, they were overwhelmed by terrifying visions; their unyielding stone was made to tremble above them.
And among them, the dead were as one who falls in another place; the cause of their death was made known unto them.
Why should evil befall them, and why should they not know that it is to destroy them? For the dreams that have come upon them have declared this beforehand.

sections.title: And concerning the commandment that was given unto Israel, Aaron did as he was commanded.

verses.text: There are those who, before the righteous, suffer affliction that leads to death. In the wilderness, they were made desolate, and many among them were destroyed. Yet, the desolation did not endure for a long time.

A man devoid of light, when he prays, he holds the instrument of service that strengthens him in his supplication, and he hastens, bearing the garment of humility, and he has found the ability to confess his sins; he has opposed the time, and has made the desolation silent. Thus, he has made himself known as your messenger.

He has overcome the adversaries; it is not by fleshly strength or by the weapons of war; rather, by reflecting upon the covenant of the fathers and their words, he has cast out the adversary by your word.
Their multitude is beyond counting; when death came upon them, they stood among the sick and the living, and he made the desolation silent. For the living, he has prepared a way.
The priesthood of the world was upon his garment, and the four corners of the sea were adorned with the glory of the one who is exalted, for your majesty was upon his own crown.
Thus, those who are consumed are forsaken; these works are necessary for them; yet, the desolation alone was in abundance.

sections.title: The Egyptians were given as a gift to the sea of Eritrea.

verses.text: Yet upon the wicked, Thy wrath shall be fulfilled until they are consumed; Thy decree is established. Their deeds are known beforehand, for they have been made manifest.

Behold, they have turned back from their journey; and again, in great distress, they have been overwhelmed; in the time of their calamity, they were driven away, and before them was a storm, and they followed after it.

While they were still in anguish, when they cried out upon their graves, a peculiar thought of torment seized them; that they might depart from among them, as those who are forsaken, they were driven away in the storm.

The end of their affliction has come upon this work; their torment has been revealed, and the judgment upon them shall be executed according to the number of their transgressions, and they shall be filled with the anguish they have not considered.
But your kindred have walked in a marvelous way, and they have encountered the evil death.

sections.title: The Lord shall keep Israel as a shepherd doth his flock and as a father doth his children.

verses.text: The creation was entirely turned away from its kin; your children, without fault, shall be kept safe, for it was commanded that they be preserved.

The cloud overshadowed us, and her waters were seen to be more abundant than before; the land that had become barren was seen to be a field that was not desolate; and in the midst of the sea of Eritrea, a path was seen that was not obstructed.

With your glorious hand and your high arm, your kin were seen to be in the midst of a mighty gathering; and the field that was not desolate was seen; when they beheld your wondrous works, they gave thanks for this hand of yours.
O Lord, they who have been saved by you, as they gave thanks to you, were heard like horses, and like the young of the wild oxen they were exalted.

In the land of the stranger, during the time they were in hospitality, all that they did was remembered; how did their land bring forth the hornet by bringing forth beasts? How did the sea bring forth the fish that were in the great waters?

After this, at the time of their gathering, they beheld a new creature of the sea, and they desired the food of delight and joy; and at the time of their longing, much abundance came forth from the sea to satisfy their many desires.

The former was not like the latter; for it came forth by the power of the miracle that was performed, and the power of the holy was upon them; for they were truly weighed according to their iniquities.

Concerning the receiving of strangers, they have greatly despised the custom; and when these who did not know them came, they did not receive them; but when they did good, they were troubled by those who had dwelt among them in hospitality.
This is not only so, but it is also to be a guide and a rule for their work; for they were to receive those who were strangers with great care.
Yet these, by celebrating the feast, received them, and the righteous who were of one law with them were afflicted with great sorrow.
Therefore, the righteous are gathered as those who have lost their brightness; they have been engulfed in deep darkness, and each of them sought the entrance of their house, the way of the righteous.

For their lights had been turned away from their seas; knowing the matter of the song, as the name of the one who is in the song is changed, so too, being the dawn, it remains steadfast in the song, and in each of their generations, the work that was created is entirely to be seen, thus it is.

sections.title: The miraculous power of the Lord.

verses.text: The creatures that dwell in dryness have returned unto the waters; and those that move in the waters and swim, their life hath returned unto the depths.
And the fire within the water was utterly quenched, and the water hath gathered the nature of the sea.

The fire that is consumed is not the work of the flame; amidst them, it is neither here nor there, and as it turns about, it hath not devoured the flesh of the beasts. The unconsumed portion of the creatures, the fire also, swiftly doth not consume the residue. O Lord, in all Thy works, let Thy glory be fulfilled and magnified. In all things, Thou hast honored them, and in all that cometh unto us, Thy goodness hath not forsaken us; neither hast Thou, at any time, left us in distress, for in every place, Thou dost abide.
